cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.09% · WTI -3.74% · Brent -1.65% · NatGas -1.77%. At the last close, 64% of 67 energy names were green — a broad bid. Shale & E&P did the heavy lifting at +3.82%.

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +3.82%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.23%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -15.74%
cards.body: Leaders: AR +6.06%, OVV +4.84%, EQNR +4.59%, TRGP +4.37%, FANG +4.27%. Laggards: EOSE -15.74%, FLNC -9.80%, LEU -9.50%, OKLO -6.80%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
